value.signature: fn validate_history < H : ClosureHeader > (acts : Vec < ClosureAct < H > > , names : & [PublicReference] ,) -> Result < ClosureHistory < H > , ValidationError >

review.body: { let mut references = BTreeSet :: new () ; for name in names { if ! matches ! (name , PublicReference :: Named { .. }) || ! valid_reference (name) { return Err (ValidationError :: InvalidReference (name . clone ())) ; } references . insert (name . clone ()) ; } let mut indices = BTreeMap :: new () ; for (index , act) in acts . iter () . enumerate () { if indices . insert (act . id () . clone () , index) . is_some () { return Err (ValidationError :: DuplicateAct (act . id () . clone ())) ; } references . insert (PublicReference :: Act (act . id () . clone ())) ; for leg in act . header . legs () { references . insert (PublicReference :: Edge (leg . id . clone ())) ; if mints (act . id () , act . header . body () . layout , leg . id . role , leg . target) { references . insert (PublicReference :: Minted (act . id () . clone ())) ; } } } for act in & acts { validate_structure (act , & references) ? ; } validate_order (acts . iter () . map (| act | (act . id () , (act . epoch , act . position)))) ? ; let available : BTreeMap < _ , _ > = acts . iter () . map (| act | (act . id () , ((act . epoch , act . position) , act . logical_time))) . collect () ; let mut parent_faults = Vec :: new () ; for act in & acts { parent_faults . extend (parent_faults_structural (& act . structural (None) , & available) ?) ; } Ok (ClosureHistory { acts , indices , references , parent_faults , }) }
